hotels.title: Family-Friendly Farm Glamping near Bundaberg with Breakfast Hamper & Animal Feeding Experience
hotels.description: Treat the family to a self-contained glamping experience and country escape at this peaceful property, home to a much-loved community of rescued animals. Just a short drive from the heritage sugar cane city of Bundaberg, this 160-acre farm keeps the wider region and Southern Great Barrier Reef within easy reach, while still giving you space to slow down into Queensland’s rural beauty. This sweeping farm is a playground for native species such as wallabies, platypus and 150 documented varieties of Australian birds. During your stay, get up close with the property’s friendly residents, wandering through the farm and feeding horses, goats and alpacas. At the end of a long day of fun, take a seat by your fire pit and gaze up at the glittering night sky.
